newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns A- longterm rating to Swedish Match.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A- longterm rating to Swedish Match.

text.p: U.S. ratings agency S&P said on Wednesday it assigned an A- longterm corporate credit rating with a stable outlook and an A-2/K-1 shortterm corporate credit rating to Swedish tobacco company Swedish Match.
At the same time, Swedish Match's two billion crown bank loan is rated single A minus, Standard & Poor's said in a statement.

"The ratings reflect Swedish Match's broad product portfolio and geographic spread in its core tobacco products businesses, in conjunction with a conservative balance sheet and a currently near risk free financial profile," S&P said.

The stable outlook incorporates the likely continuation of conservative financial policies and a strong balance sheet, which will cushion ongoing pressures, both competitive and otherwise, on its base business, the agency said.
"As the company is already given credit for its significant financial flexibility, any future rating changes would probably be influenced by a change in the business risk profile," S&P said.
"Standard & Poor's does not expect the company to make acquisitions outside of its current main businesses."

Swedish Match's revolving credit facility is rated at the same level as the corporate credit rating because unsecured bank creditors rank equally with other senior unsecured creditors, the agency said.
